text:
Rina: Quick pre-launch thread : landing + benchmark blog need final SEO tasks: canonical, KW map, redirects, JSON-LD, internal links, and inbound tagging. Who can pick up which piece?

Omar: I can own canonical + meta. Proposed canonical: /webinars/inference-playbook-2026 (keeps year for clarity). Meta title: "Inference Playbook: Cost vs Latency | Redwood". Meta description draft: "Join our webinar for benchmark-driven strategies to lower LLM inference cost without sacrificing latency. Register now."

Liam: Keyword shortlist for page and blog H2s: primary: ["inference economics", "reduce inference cost", "inference latency optimization"]; secondary: ["dedicated inference", "private LLM deployment"]. I'll drop the KW map into the content doc and suggest H1/H2 swaps.

Jules: I'll handle redirects and Netlify PR. Draft _redirects (one-to-one 301s):
```
/old-webinar-inference            /webinars/inference-playbook-2026   301
/webinar-inference-legacy         /webinars/inference-playbook-2026   301
/posts/inference-costs-draft      /benchmarks/inference-economics     301
```
Note: preserve UTM query params and avoid chains. I'll run the checker pre-PR.

Rina: Structured data reqs: Event + VideoObject + FAQ + Organization. Keep JSON-LD minimal and validate in Rich Results. Example for Event (short):
```json
{ "@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Inference Playbook","startDate":"2026-06-09T17:00:00Z","location":{"@type":"VirtualLocation","url":"https://redwood.ai/webinars/inference-playbook-2026"} }
```
Add FAQ pairs for "Will there be a recording?" and "Is this relevant for private deployments?"

Omar: Inbound routing: set utm_campaign=webinar_playbook_jun. Hidden form fields: utm_campaign + source=webinar_playbook. HubSpot workflow: tag leads with webinar_playbook, set lifecycle=MQL if attended OR watched recording, and assign to AE queue for companies >50 employees.

Liam: Internal linking plan: add 3 contextual links from /docs/inference/overview, /benchmarks/latency-cost, and /blog/serving-patterns to the webinar page. Use anchor text variations: "inference playbook", "inference economics webinar". Add a banner CTA on docs pages. Also add rel=canonical on any duplicate tag or archive pages.

TrackerBot: Crawl scheduled at 2042009200 : will report redirect chains >1 hop, missing canonical tags, 404s, and any JSON-LD schema errors.

Jules: I'll open the redirect PR at 10:45 PT and include Netlify preview + redirect-checker output. Leaving a note to avoid linking the old tag pages directly; canonicalize instead.

Rina: Great. Omar/Liam/Jules, add your PR/board links to the launch spreadsheet under Owner. Hold email sends until TrackerBot returns a clean run. Thanks :thumbsup:
